heading: Clients feedback
lede: What the people on the other side of the handoff said afterwards.

testimonials.quote: She rebuilt our product page around the one question customers kept emailing us about. The emails stopped.
testimonials.name: Priya Raghunathan

testimonials.quote: We had a design system on paper and nothing in the theme. Kashish shipped both, and wrote down why every token existed so the next person would not have to ask.
testimonials.name: Tomas Lindqvist

testimonials.quote: She spent the first week reading our support tickets instead of opening Figma. Everything she designed after that was aimed at something real.
testimonials.name: Amara Diallo
